thread:
sam: Heads-up 1: we have an embargoed analyst + press briefing on Thu 8/1 at 09:00am PT. Embargo lifts Wed 7/31 4:00pm PT. Need final quote + sign-off by Tue EOD to give PR agency time to prep. cc @mia @jordan
mia: Got it. Who's the quote owner? I can take comms while jordan handles the tech stat.
jordan: I'll pull the internal perf numbers and a short non-numeric line about batching + cache. aim for 1 sentence.
elise: I'll confirm spokes: @elise (product), @jordan (applied-ml), and @sam (ceo) possible. PR agency wants preferred embargo distribution list by Tue noon.
tom (legal): ping me the quote draft once it's in here. we'll avoid absolutes and any comparative claims without attribution.
press_bot: Embargo set: 2024-07-31T16:00:00-07:00 (PT). Briefing: 2024-08-01T09:00:00-07:00 PT. Attendees: select press + 2 analysts. Organizer: sam@redwood.ai
sam: Proposal for quote draft from comms:
"Redwood Inference helps teams serve LLMs reliably in production; customers note meaningful latency improvements and lower unit costs when using Dedicated capacity and our batching/caching features."
mia: Nice. Make "customers note" -> "some customers report" for legal. Also maybe shorten "lower unit costs" -> "reduced unit costs"
jordan: Tech add-on (one-liner): "Optimized batching and KV-cache reuse reduce per-token work for recurring contexts."
tom (legal): Suggest edits: change to "some customers report" and remove any unnamed percent claims. Also replace "reduce" with "can reduce".
sam: Updated quote per legal:
"Redwood Inference helps teams serve LLMs reliably in production; some customers report meaningful latency improvements and reduced unit costs when using Dedicated capacity and our batching/caching features."
mia: OK. Can someone confirm who will be the signer? sam?
sam: I can sign. Please lock the final copy by Tue 5pm PT so I can review before signing.
elise: PR agency needs the embargo distribution and a one-paragraph supporting stat (non-numeric) for the release. jordan, can you drop 2 sentences about our test setup?
jordan: will do. short note: internal tests used real-world prompt mixes and Dedicated instances with prefix caching enabled; numbers are workload-dependent. I'll avoid raw numbers in the public paragraph.
mia: Also need an FAQ for reporters: privacy, on-prem options, and SLA language. I'll draft and post by Tue morning.
tom (legal): FYI don't promise SLA in the release unless it's already public in product docs. Add "subject to terms" if necessary.
sam: Good call. Mia add: "subject to terms" in the release body.
press_bot: Reminder scheduled: embargo distribution sends at 2024-07-31T16:00:00-07:00.
mia: Plan checklist: 1) jordan posts 2-sentence tech blurb by Tue 11am, 2) final quote locked by Tue 5pm, 3) sam signs Wed morning, 4) embargoed send Wed 4pm PT, 5) briefing Thu 9am PT.
elise: Confirm PR agency will run invite for press; we'll run analyst invites directly.
sam: Anything else? If not, I'll ask PR to prepare the press list and send me the embargo distribution for review.
mia: all good from me. I'll post a final package once sam signs. :white_check_mark:
